fr_html: Le PRESIDENT explique que l'article 22 du projet Root—Phillimore repose sur l'idée de donner aux juges une pension variant avec la durée effective de leurs fonctions.
en_html: The PRESIDENT explained that Article 22 of the Root—Phillimore plan was based upon the idea of giving the judges a pension which would vary according to the actual duration of their appointments.
